title: Putting a Defaulted Patient Payment Plan Back in Force
content:
Under **Patient Payment Plans**, a defaulted plan put back in force inside its reinstatement window is reinstated with a reinstated installment.

## What reinstatement books
On reinstatement the re-enrolled amount of the invoice still open is booked again on the same plan with the reinstatement itself, the reinstated installment this rule sets out takes the place of the original schedule's installment, and the invoice leaves the statement cycle again.

Invoices can be enrolled only while the plan status is pending acceptance or active, and on a defaulted plan only as the re-enrollment booked with its reinstatement.

## When the installment is fixed
A reinstated installment is fixed only after the plan ledger carries an arrears payment dated after the plan's default date.

In other words, the plan ledger must show an arrears payment whose date is later than the default date recorded on the plan; an arrears payment dated on or before the default date does not meet this condition.

| Arrears payment on the plan ledger | Dated after the plan's default date | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| None since the default | — | Not met — the reinstated installment is not fixed |
| Present | No (on or before the default date) | Not met |
| Present | Yes | Met |

## How the reinstatement is booked
Reinstatement is booked with the agent-side tool `reinstate_plan_60f00772`. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call puts the patient's defaulted plan back in force: it returns the plan to active status, adds one to the plan's reinstatement count (the default date is kept as history), books the named invoice's balance back onto the plan's activity as an enrollment dated today, raises the plan's balance figure by that amount and sets the plan's regular monthly installment. The patient's plan shows as active again, with the invoice on it and the new installment on the next statement.

## Parameters
- `plan_id` — the reference number of the patient's payment plan, as the payment-plan lookup shows it. Identifier.
- `invoice_id` — the reference number of the invoice whose balance goes back onto the plan, as the invoice lookup shows it. Identifier.
- `reenrolled_amount` — the invoice balance booked back onto the plan, in USD: a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent.
- `installment_amount` — the plan's regular monthly installment once it is back in force, in USD: a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Return
On success the tool returns `enrollment_id` (the reference of the enrollment line), `plan_id`, `plan_status` ("active"), `reinstatement_count` (a whole number, the count after this reinstatement), `plan_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `installment_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places). A returned `plan_status` of active means the plan is back in force.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)
A call with the plan's reference, the open invoice's reference, a `reenrolled_amount` of 640.00 and an `installment_amount` of 118.25 returns an enrollment reference, the status "active", the reinstatement count raised by one, the plan balance raised by 640.00 and the installment 118.25.
